reports.title: Pinterest Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results, Delivers 12%

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: For Q4 2026, we expect revenue to be in the range of $1,425 million to $1,475 million, representing 8% - 12% growth year over year, which assumes a modest headwind from foreign exchange based on current spot rates. We expect Q4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA* to be in the range of $538 million to $588 million.
We intend to provide further details on our outlook during the conference call.
